payload.set_intro: A soccer ball is kicked from a level field with an initial speed of $24\text{ m/s}$ at an angle of $53^\circ$ above the horizontal. The ball lands on the same level field. Air resistance is negligible.

items.stem: What is the speed of the ball at the highest point of its flight?

options.why: Reports the full launch speed, assuming the speed does not change on the way up.
Halves the launch speed, assuming the ball has lost half of its speed at the top.
Reports the vertical component of the launch velocity instead of the horizontal one.
At the top the vertical velocity is zero and the horizontal velocity has not changed, so the speed is $v_0\cos\theta=(24)\cos 53^\circ=14.4\text{ m/s}$.

The correct answer is $14.4\text{ m/s}$. At the top the vertical velocity is zero and the horizontal velocity has not changed, so the speed is $v_0\cos\theta=(24)\cos 53^\circ=14.4\text{ m/s}$.
$24.0\text{ m/s}$ is incorrect: Reports the full launch speed, assuming the speed does not change on the way up.
$12.0\text{ m/s}$ is incorrect: Halves the launch speed, assuming the ball has lost half of its speed at the top.
$19.2\text{ m/s}$ is incorrect: Reports the vertical component of the launch velocity instead of the horizontal one.
